speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA) - specifically the polyarticular or oligoarticular subtype, presenting as a monoarticular onset in a 24-year-old male with inflammatory signs (night pain, NSAID failure, persistent swelling) and no history of trauma or infection.
